summary: This paper resolves four major open structural questions in almost-linear single-source shortest paths by establishing exact radial excursion thresholds, p-band tower conservation, an unconditional Las Vegas Omega(N log log log N) decision barrier, and a 172-order-of-magnitude outer threshold sharpening. The work is impeccably supported by 20 machine-checked Lean 4 theorems and an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier.
strengths: Exact radial excursion threshold K_crit(alpha) = 2/(1-alpha) and K=8 sharpening.
p-band tower conservation law separating disjoint-set work from the octave-decision barrier.
Machine-checked Lean 4 verification and 16 SHA-256 zero-float certificates.
weaknesses: Dense with advanced algorithmic terminology in Sections 2-5.
strong_novelty_candidates: Unconditional Las Vegas Omega(N log log log N) octave-decision barrier.
